About Slop Projects

Slop Projects plans the work of a small business. Each project has a board of columns, To do, Doing and Done to start with, which you can rename, reorder and give a limit of cards, so a crowded column shows in red. Drag cards across the board, or move them with the keyboard. Each task can have a description, a person, a priority, tags, a checklist, a start and an end, a due day, a customer from Slop CRM, and the tasks it waits for. The timeline shows the dated tasks as bars on a scale of days, weeks or months, with arrows between the tasks that wait for each other and a line for today; drag a bar to move it or its ends to change the dates, and the tasks after it move on so nothing starts too early. The list sorts every task by any column. Every move and delete can be undone. Save a project as a JSON backup, open it again anywhere, or download its tasks as CSV for a spreadsheet. Everything stays in this browser, and nothing is uploaded.
